title: edges.json — exposure and cascade edges contract
description: Dyadic exposure edges (doc 01 §3.1, the model's primitive object) and cascade edges (doc 01 §6). Schema-enforced rules: every cascade edge carries a concrete mechanism string (with a pattern-level rejection of 'neighbors correlate' phrasings — the review UI enforces the full rule) and a ledger reference (doc 04: every emitted cascade edge generates a ledger entry); cascade edges are structurally marked projection:true (§2.3 no projection/observation mixing); exposure edges must be decomposable to evidence; doc 07 F-2 controller_id is required with no null branch and a stored 'direction' is structurally forbidden. Not schema-enforceable: mechanism concreteness beyond the pattern check, edge-weight math, hedging-prior consistency, controller_id resolution into controllers.json, direction_derived/pole derivation correctness, consortium mixed_control correctness (validate.py, doc 07 §4).

exposureEdge.description: (country, controller, layer) → exposure attributes. Country scores are derived from these edges, never asserted (doc 01 §3.2); this file is what the alignment_index one-tap decomposition resolves to (doc 02 regression test 2). Doc 07 F-2: controller_id is required with no null branch — there is no such thing as an exposure to an unidentified controller; a stored 'direction' field is structurally forbidden (not listed below, and this object is additionalProperties:false) — direction is derived from the controller (direction_derived), never coded beside it.

d_share.description: This controller's installed-base share at this layer.

p.description: Applicable P sub-indicators on this edge; only the relevant ones appear, each evidenced-or-null.

sub_state_actor.description: Doc 01 §5: edges may attach to sub-state entities, rolled up for the map but preserved here.

bundle_ids.description: Doc 01 §2.5: edges created by packaged commitments carry the bundle reference; renewal analysis treats the bundle as the unit of decision.

evidence_refs.description: event_ids. No edge without coded evidence (§2.3 no unsourced deltas).

direction_derived.description: Doc 07 F-7 rule 3: computed from the controller, never asserted. validate.py check_direction_derived verifies value correctness against controllers.json + pole_map.json.

mixed_control.description: Doc 07 F-7 rule 6: set when the edge's controller is a consortium with no documented controlling member — the scoring pipeline can split by evidenced shares or disclose 'unsplit', but never silently pick a pole.

projection.description: §2.3: cascade layers are always-labeled projections, never mixed with observed data. The constant makes mislabeling a validation failure.

mechanism.description: Doc 01 §6 rule 1: a concrete channel — a named interconnector, creditor, bundle, or sub-state actor. The pattern check catches the canonical lazy phrasings; the review UI enforces the substantive rule.

ledger_ref.description: Doc 04 Class A: every cascade edge generates a ledger entry; this is its prediction_id.

network_basis.description: Which §3.2 network metrics contributed (e.g. shared_controller_centrality, single_creditor_concentration).
